title: Affine lifting of quotient sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:\mathcal I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ quasi-coherent and of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P_n=\mathcal I^n$ with inclusion $j_n:P_n\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ and $P_0=\mathcal O_X$, using the recursive ideal powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Let $\mathcal F$ be quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open, with $x\in U$ iff $\iota_x$ is surjective. Fix $1_n\in P_n(U)$ with $j_n(1_n)=1$. For each $n$ fix a quasi-coherent module $A_n$, a monomorphism $a_n:A_n\to\mathcal F$, and require that its image on every open $W$ is exactly the sections $t$ satisfying $j_n(b)t|_{W'}=0$ for every $W'\subseteq W$ and $b\in P_n(W')$. Write $Q_n=\operatorname{coker}(a_n)$ and $\pi_n:\mathcal F\to Q_n$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and require $\pi_n(W)$ bijective whenever $W\subseteq U$. For every affine open $V\subseteq X$ and $s\in\mathcal F(U)$, there exist $n$ and an $\mathcal O_V$-linear morphism $\varphi:P_n|_V\to Q_n|_V$ such that for every open $W\subseteq U\cap V$, $\pi_n(s|_W)=\varphi_W(1_n|_W)$. No compactness or quasi-separatedness of $X$ is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), proof; Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM.

proof.text: Apply the affine denominator-map construction to obtain n, K, and f:P_n(V)->F(V)/K with its restriction formula on global affine sections, and quasi-coherence of P_n.

Since K is contained in the range of a_n(V), a_n followed by pi_n = 0 shows K is contained in the kernel of pi_n(V). Descend pi_n(V) through K by Submodule.liftQ and compose with f. Naturality of pi_n and surjectivity of the quotient projection turn the representative formula into the scalar formula for this composed linear map.
Extend the composed linear map to phi:P_n|V -> Q_n|V with its prescribed value on V.

For a section b on W inside U intersect V, choose around each point a principal open D(r) inside W. Quasi-coherence supplies k and c in P_n(V) with c|D(r)=r^k b|D(r). Naturality of phi and its value on V give the scalar formula for c|D(r); linearity and naturality of j_n give the formula for r^k b|D(r). The restricted r is a unit, so cancel its kth power. Sheaf separation gives the formula for b on W. Empty W is included by separation.
Apply the scalar formula to the restriction of one n. Naturality of j_n and hone make its image equal to 1 on W. Scalar multiplication by 1 and naturality of pi_n give the required identity.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 01PM and 01PQ; quotient descent and principal-open scalar-identity argument formalized by J1 using the proved upstream affine localization lemma.

theorem ideal_power_quotient_affine_lifting_section
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (one : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, U))
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (idealSheafPower ι n).2.app U (one n) = (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    (A : ℕ → X.Modules) (a : ∀ n : ℕ, A n ⟶ F)
    (hmono : ∀ n : ℕ, Mono (a n))
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℕ, (A n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hann : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(F, W)),
      s ∈ Set.range ((a n).app W) ↔
        ∀ (W' : X.Opens) (h : W' ≤ W)
          (b : Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, W')),
          (F.smul (U := W') ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.val.app (op W') b)).hom
            (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) = 0)
    (hquot : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U →
      Function.Bijective ((cokernel.π (a n)).app W))
    (V : X.affineOpens) :
    ∀ s : Γ(F, U), ∃ (n : ℕ)
      (φ : ((idealSheafPower ι n).1).over V.1 ⟶ (cokernel (a n)).over V.1),
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V.1),
        (cokernel.π (a n)).app W (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op s) =
          φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hWV)))
            (((idealSheafPower ι n).1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (one n))
